note: HOST-OWNED. TaskProfile.runnerRef / compilerRef / verifierRef are opaque strings. This file maps them to concrete in-repo implementations. Nothing here is ever taken from a request: a caller names a profile id, and the host resolves the executable from this table. A request that carries its own runnerPath / interpreterPath / argv / executable is refused with POLICY_DENIED before any other validation runs.
rule: A ref that is not present in this file, or whose symbol is not registered in packages/evolver/src/domain/task-profile.ts, is UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY. There is no fallback runner.

runtime.note: Runtime pins are host-owned. A request may not change the timeout, the learning rate, the batch size or the data spec; prepareRun reads them from here. slotChannels=8 is the baseline Conv2d(3->8) output width and is asserted against the slot schema on load. The data spec is a REAL licensed dataset (Oxford-IIIT Pet trimap annotations, CC BY-SA 4.0), prepared once by scripts/prepare-phase3-real-data.ts and pinned by hash: the runner verifies those bytes before reading them, so a slice that changed on disk is CONTRACT_DATA_MISMATCH rather than a different experiment under the same run identity.

pinnedModules.provenance: fixtures/modules/manifest.json id/name/implementationPath/implementationHash; mechanismKind is the host's classification under MECHANISM_KINDS, not the P6 interventionAxis label
fixtures/modules/manifest.json id/name/implementationPath/implementationHash; mechanismKind is the host's classification under MECHANISM_KINDS, not the P6 interventionAxis label

fixtures/modules/manifest.json id/name/implementationPath/implementationHash + candidateBinding; mechanismKind is the host's classification under MECHANISM_KINDS, NOT the P6 interventionAxis label attention_implementation, which is not a MECHANISM_KINDS member

phase2-cpu-seg-v1.pinnedModuleRule: Only the modules in this table may appear in a binding. A module id that is not here is NOT_FOUND, and a module path supplied by a request is refused by assertNoRequestSuppliedExecutable. Adding a module is a host configuration change, not a request parameter.

runner:phase2-cpu-seg-v1.description: Spawns the pinned CPU runner as a real child process using the argv this registry builds, and returns real process facts.
runner:phase2-cpu-seg-v1.argvRule: Every argv element comes from this registry or from the host-built manifest path. No element is request-supplied.

compiler:phase2-cpu-seg-v1.description: Builds a variant recipe from module ids + bindings. Never from hardcoded A/B names.

verifier:phase2-cpu-seg-v1.description: Host-side verification of one run: identity, hashes, declared budget, environment pin and per-module mechanism facts.
